question: set an alarm
answer: You can set an alarm by going to your device's settings or app that handles alarms and setting the time you want it to go off.
paraphrases: set an alarm for tomorrow at 5:15
set an alarm to start work
set an alarm to stop work
log_examples: set an alarm for 05:00 and one for 16:00
